objectClass.notes: Static branded retail box on thaikit's shared building module (8.0 x 4.6 x 7.0 m envelope), exterior shell only. The old NB2 word had a ~25 degree slant and NO p descender, so the p sat high and the word read as rotated clockwise; the new one was asked for a level baseline, ~12 degree slant and a descender, and its two t bottoms measure level (503/503 px) with the p 126 px below. The old flame was force-fitted into a 0.38 x 0.78 m box (0.49) while the plate's flame measures 33 x 58 px = 0.57; the new flame's own ink is 0.607 (mirror IoU 0.995 before symmetrising) and each mark is now sized by HEIGHT with the width following its own ink aspect: emblem 0.45 x 0.75 m at x 0.47..0.92, word 0.84 x 0.48 m at x 0.96..1.80. FOURTH build (2026-09-02), revision d (user direction): the module is 8 x 4.6 x 10 m (declared depth 10.0 with the arithmetic in the asset notes) so the forecourt canopy in front of the kiosk is 6.0 m, TWICE the 3.0 m it had -- slab z -5..5, kiosk z -5..-1 under the rear 4 m, columns at z 4.22, six rib rows over the 5.86 m strip; the +X edge carries the navy band, white coping and red stripe like the front and -X (three atlas slots, sign/compose6.py); and the flame is a fresh Nano Banana 2 generation keyed, centred on its centroid and SYMMETRISED about its vertical axis (alpha = max(mask, mirror)), its mirror IoU printed by the composer as the measurement that it is straight. Revision b: the enclosed kiosk is the FULL WIDTH of the slab under its rear half (x -3.99..3.99, z -3.495..0.5, its -X, +X and rear walls flush with the slab faces), so ONE straight upstand at z -1.0 (revision d) divides the roof into the kiosk's membrane roof behind and the ribbed canopy strip in front, and the 6 m front strip on two columns is the only open canopy -- the user's direction on the plate (the kiosk fills half the roof), overriding the earlier L-plan that put the kiosk under the rear-right. Rebuilt after the tree entry was reset: the third build's structural reading is kept (the 2026-09-01 Meshy v7 ultra proxy, request 01a06002-557b-7370-8470-c6e75983b5be, its top-down maps and the plate's panel-joint pitch as the ruler for every x, scratch/_ptt/; the right column read off the plate at 258:75:12:7 px for column:navy:red:coping); the MARK is re-measured at the plate's real size (band rows 403..475 = 0.94 m at ~77 px/m: emblem 33 x 58 px = 0.45 x 0.75 m = 0.80 of the band, word 63 x 37 px = 0.84 x 0.48 m, x 0.47..1.80 -- the third build's 0.50 m flame was two thirds of it); deck, membrane, frame and glass tones re-measured off the plate (evidence.mjs crops: deck #757D85, membrane #777B7F, frame #C1C2C0, glass #494D4E); and every Nano Banana 2 texture regenerated (sign/compose4.py, mirrored in scratch/_ptt/v4/). A filling-station forecourt kiosk: the whole prop is ONE 8 x 10 m roof slab at 4.60 with a 1.2 m deep edge fascia -- soffit 3.40, red stripe 3.40..3.56, navy band 3.56..4.50 carrying the ptt mark on the street face and wrapping BOTH the -X and +X edges, a white coping 4.50..4.60 all round and a 0.30 m wide white parapet ring -- over a ribbed metal canopy deck. The enclosed kiosk (white render, x -3.89..3.99, z -4.995..-1.0) stands under the slab's rear 4 m, the full width, with its +X and rear walls FLUSH with the slab faces, so the canopy is a 6 m strip across the whole front on two square render columns at x +-1.95. Its front is six bays of aluminium-framed glass on a 0.45 m rail across the whole width, the sliding door one of them, with two more bays on the -X wall; a grey membrane roof with a 0.28 m upstand carries one large and two small condensers; a flush white service door sits near the rear of the +X wall.

silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -4.00..+4.00 (parapet ring outer faces) = 8.00. y spans 0.00..4.60 = 4.60. z spans -3.50 (rear parapet) ..+3.50 = 7.00. The shell front face is set back to z=+2.50 so anything cantilevering off it lands ON the declared depth rather than overrunning it.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: No new proxy for the fourth build: reference.glb was deleted with the reset and the 2026-09-01 proxy's reading below stands (two proxies in a row mirrored the plan, so a third would add cost and no evidence). Meshy v7 ultra reconstruction (2026-09-01, seed 22500251) normalises to w:h:d = 1 : 0.580 : 1.244 against the declared 1 : 0.575 : 0.875 -- height within 1%, 42% deeper, the same depth bias as the first proxy. Its top-down maps (scratch/_ptt/top.mjs) confirm ONE slab with a parapet ring on every edge, two columns near the front edge and the condensers on the kiosk roof; but it reads the kiosk as a FULL-WIDTH box with mirrored columns at +-2.8 m, which is symmetry_mode=auto -- the plate shows backdrop between the left column and the glazing (scratch/_ptt/left_corner.png), which an L-plan would explain; revision b builds the full-width kiosk on the user's direction and records that as a residual. The declared 8.0 x 4.6 x 10.0 m (revision d: the kit's 7.0 m retail module deepened by 3 m of canopy on user direction) wins; column x comes from the plate: the right column stands at the mark's right edge, three 1 m panels from the band's end, in front of the gap between the two glazed units.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the hero2x class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Three repetition systems collapse 295 discrete parts into 3 submissions. Slab, ring, upstands, columns and door leaf fold into the parapet; both navy boards into the fascia; the stripe's three runs into one component; the door fittings and pipe into a fifth. Eleven of twelve.

materials.note: wall covers the kiosk, slab, ring, upstands, columns and door leaf; deck covers the membrane, the canopy deck, the backdrop slab and the ribs (vertex/instance tones on a white base); frame covers the framing and mullions; galv the plant and fittings. Seven of eight.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: Triangles are NOT the binding constraint on this prop -- draw calls are. The headroom is deliberately spent on silhouette quality (chamfers, cowl segments, shutter ribs) and must not be read as room to split components, which would spend the axis that is actually scarce.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: box, cylinder and merged-box clusters only. No organic surfaces exist on this subject.
Three InstancedMesh systems carry 295 of the ~320 discrete parts.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.

Every material is declared textureless. The brand fascia receives its wordmark as a generated canvas assigned AFTER material construction -- the documented route for a printed brand fascia, unaffected by the declaration.
